analysis.title: Firefly Aerospace (FLY): 3Q26 First Take: solid qtr, next Alpha movement, overall strong demand
key_insights: FLY 3Q26 revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS all came in above consensus. Revenue was $110.7mn, 8% above FactSet consensus.
FLY raised the low end of its 2026 revenue guidance to $440-$450mn from $420-$450mn, lifting the midpoint by about 2%. Consensus was $439mn.
A national security customer directed a readjustment to the Alpha launch manifest. Alpha Flight 8 now targets 1Q27, previously 4Q26. The company said it preferred to launch before year-end.
FLY will provide a 2027 launch target on its 4Q26 earnings call.
FLY announced a multi-launch agreement with Synspective for up to 10 Alpha missions through 2030.
FLY signed a contract worth more than $1.3bn with AST SpaceMobile. It covers delivery of 36 rocket engines, a license to the engine's intellectual property, and engineering support.
Free cash flow was $(85.3)mn in the quarter versus $(106.3)mn in the prior quarter.
GS rates FLY Neutral with a 12-month price target of $32, which implies 35.0% upside from $23.70. The target is based on 5.5X 2028E EV/Sales.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral rating and $32 12-month target reiterated after the 3Q26 print. The target is based on 5.5X 2028E EV/Sales.

earnings_insights: FLY 3Q26 reported revenue $110.7mn vs FactSet consensus about $102.5mn (8% above), vs GS estimate $104.0mn (6.5% above), up 259.6% y/y from $30.8mn in 3Q25.
FLY 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA $(69.5)mn reported vs FactSet consensus $(77.5)mn and GS estimate $(69.6)mn.
FLY 3Q26 adjusted diluted EPS $(0.45) reported vs GS estimate $(0.47) and $(0.55) in 3Q25. Diluted shares were 168.4mn vs GS estimate 162.8mn.
FLY 3Q26 reported EBIT $(101.6)mn vs GS estimate $(91.6)mn. Adjusted net income was $(75.4)mn vs GS estimate $(76.9)mn.
FLY 2026 revenue guidance is now $440-$450mn, from $420-$450mn prior. FactSet consensus for 2026 revenue before the update was $439mn.
GS forecasts revenue of $442.3mn for 2026E, $730.3mn for 2027E and $1,070.4mn for 2028E. GS forecasts EBITDA of $(267.6)mn for 2026E, $(124.0)mn for 2027E and $36.6mn for 2028E.
risk_factors: A national security customer's direction changed the Alpha launch manifest and pushed Flight 8 into 1Q27.
